South and North together bring in about two-thirds of the revenue. The board also has a chart of monthly revenue for each region. October is only a partial month.

These figures are after discounts: 253 orders were billed at 10% below list price.

I've made the board: monthly revenue for Jan–Oct 2026, with one line each for East, North, South and West. No browser has the board app open yet, so open **http://localhost:4710** to see it.

- **South** has been highest most months and peaked in September at ₹15,94,090.
- **North** was highest in January and February, then mostly fell after that.
- **East** and **West** are lower, mostly between ₹3–8 lakh a month.
- **October** only has orders up to today (21 Oct), so its dip is because the month isn't finished.

I also saved it as a recipe (`monthly_revenue_by_region`), so the same chart for another year is one call.

I've changed the board to quarterly bars, one per region. The app still isn't open in a browser, so open **http://localhost:4710** to see it.

- **South** was the highest region every quarter and rose each quarter, reaching ₹37,05,310 in Q3.
- **North** came second but dropped each quarter, from ₹32,57,320 in Q1 to ₹27,18,740 in Q3.
- **West** grew steadily, to ₹19,13,190 in Q3.
- **East** peaked in Q2 at ₹19,87,210.
- **Q4** only has orders up to 21 Oct, and the board has a note saying so.

I saved this one as a recipe too (`quarterly_revenue_by_region`).

All four regions are behind their 2026 targets through September:

| Region | Actual | Target | Gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| North | ₹89.07L | ₹107.66L | **−₹18.59L (−17.3%)** |
| West | ₹48.92L | ₹52.42L | −₹3.50L (−6.7%) |
| South | ₹104.42L | ₹107.66L | −₹3.24L (−3.0%) |
| East | ₹50.85L | ₹52.42L | −₹1.57L (−3.0%) |

North has by far the largest gap. I compared January to September only, because October's orders only go up to the 19th, so including it would make every region look further behind than it is.
